text.p: Argentina placed 250 million pesos in 91-day treasury bills (Letes) at a discount rate of 6.40 percent and another 250 million pesos in 182-day Letes at 6.90 percent, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
The price at the discount rate of 6.40 percent on the 91-day bills was 983.822. There were 94 bids for a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.20 times.
The price at the discount rate of 6.90 percent on the 182-day bills was 965.117. There were 84 bids for a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.05 times.

The discount rate of 6.40 percent on the 91-day bills was lower than the forecasts in a Reuters poll. The lowest forecast was 6.50 percent, while for the 182-day bills the lowest prediction was 7.0 percent.
Market-makers will be offered up to 10 percent more of both issues until 1730 local/2030 GTM Tuesday.
